title: Survey your command
body: Click one of your army plates on the map, or pick an army in the outliner on the right. N finds a unit with orders; F centres it.

title: March the regiment
body: Provinces your army can reach are outlined in gold. Hover one to see the route, then click it to march.

title: Open a province
body: Right-click a province, or click one of your towns. Its panel opens on the left with its facts, production, buildings and recruitment.

title: Build an improvement
body: In the province's buildings table, press Build beside a farm, lumber mill or road. Hover a row to see what it does.

title: Raise a regiment
body: Open one of your cities and press Raise in the recruitment table. Mind the upkeep: every regiment eats food.

title: Check your supply
body: Select an army and switch to the supply map mode (press 3, or the wagon in the bottom-right bar). The green line runs back to its supply hub.

title: Consult the CARSapedia
body: Press F1 or the book in the icon bar. Search it, and follow the links between articles.

title: Inspect the network
body: Press G for the strategic atlas: the land, supply, sea and air networks the rules play on.

title: Review the replay studio
body: Press R for the replay studio. Replays verify each recorded command.

title: End the season
body: Press the round End Turn button or Space. Watch the seven rivals act, then plan your next move.
